# Mengfan Fire Safety Equipment - Hangzhou Pri-Safety Fire Technology

> > Manufacturer of automatic fire suppression systems including FM200/HFC-227 hanging extinguishers, tube extinguishers for electrical cabinets, and vehicle fire protection systems.

Mengfan, operating under Hangzhou Pri-Safety Fire Technology Co., Ltd. in Zhejiang, China, specializes in automatic fire extinguishing solutions for industrial, vehicular, and electrical applications. Products are certified to CE, ECE R107, EN3, and Fire Protection Product Certification standards.

## Key Topics

- FM200 / HFC-227 fire suppression systems
- Automatic fire extinguishers
- Hanging and self-activated extinguishers
- Dry powder fire suppression
- Electrical cabinet fire protection
- Tube fire extinguisher systems
- Vehicle fire suppression (buses, bulldozers, mining equipment)
- Pneumatic fire suppression technology
- Hangzhou Pri-Safety Fire Technology Co., Ltd.
- CE and ECE R107 certification
- Lithium battery fire safety
- Emergency car safety kits
- Wall-mounted automatic fire systems
- Mining machine fire protection
- Industrial fire safety equipment
